mentions.name: Nattokinase overexpression natto strain
mentions.description: This project genetically engineers a normal, typical natto (Japanese fermented soybean) strain to overexpress nattokinase, an enzyme clinically shown to help against blood clots, so that one serving equals one clinically relevant dose. It is the author's second home-brewed food GMO, created for fun, with an eventual goal of hosting GMO dinner parties in SF featuring only GMOs made with the author's own hands.
mentions.problem: The clinical dose of nattokinase is 5x the quantity in a serving of natto — too much natto to eat.
mentions.audience: Personal/hobby use — the author makes it for fun and plans GMO dinner parties in SF
